fn.append.description: Adds one item to the end of a list.

fn.contains.description: Tells whether a list, map, or text holds a value.

fn.div.description: Divides the first value by the second.

fn.float.description: Converts a value to a decimal number.

fn.int.description: Converts a value to a whole number.

fn.join.description: Joins a list into one text value.

fn.length.description: Number of items in a list or map, or characters in text.

fn.list.description: Builds a list from the arguments.

fn.map.description: Builds a map from [key, value] pairs.

fn.open.description: Opens a file for reading, writing, or appending.

fn.range.description: Builds a list of numbers from 1 to 3 arguments.

fn.read.description: Reads a whole file or the rest of an open file.

fn.reverse.description: Returns a reversed copy of a list or text.

fn.sort.description: Returns a sorted copy of a list.

fn.split.description: Splits text into a list of pieces.

fn.sub.description: Subtracts the second value from the first.

fn.type.description: Returns the type name of a value.

fn.wait.description: Pauses for a number of seconds.

kw.and.description: True only when both sides are true.

kw.begin.description: Alternative spelling of the opening brace.

kw.catch.description: Starts the error handler of a try block.

kw.const.description: Declares a value that cannot be changed.

kw.continue.description: Skips to the next loop turn.

kw.else.description: Starts the other branch of a conditional.

kw.end.description: Alternative spelling of the closing brace.

kw.for.description: Repeats a block once per item.

kw.import.description: Runs another file and shares its names.

kw.input.description: Reads one line of text from the user.

kw.or.description: True when either side is true.

kw.print.description: Writes a value followed by a newline.

kw.return.description: Sends a value back from a function.

kw.switch.description: Chooses the block matching a value.

kw.try.description: Starts a block whose errors can be caught.

kw.while.description: Repeats a block while a condition is true.
